description: Add a layer to a score: one voice of the music (a drum kit, a bass, a pad, a recorded sound) with its own instrument, effects, level and regions. Silent until it has a region: notes need an instrument on the part; an audio region sounds on its own. Returns the new score_id (edit that one next) and the part_id.

output.description: Where it sounds: master (default) or a part_id, to group parts under one part’s effects and level

name: score.add_part

changed.description: What the edit added, removed or modified

at.description: Where an added or modified region now starts

beats.description: Beats from the start (a quarter note is 1)

frames.description: At the score fps, exact (45.5 is half way through frame 45); absent without fps
